# Workers' Compensation Loss Reserving

A reproducible R analysis of net paid losses and allocated expenses for **Federal
Ins Co Grp (code 388)**, valued at year-end **2007**. The downloaded file contains
accident years **1998-2006** for this group. This is a portfolio study, not a
reserve recommendation for the insurer today.

## Verified results


|Method                               | Unpaid losses ($ millions)|
|:------------------------------------|--------------------------:|
|Chain-ladder / Mack (common basis)   |                    381.599|
|BF: mature-year paid ELR sensitivity |                    750.247|
|BF: CL-implied ELR sensitivity       |                    471.488|

Mack standard error: **$47.955M**; coefficient of variation:
**12.57%**. These describe the common-basis chain-ladder projection
through development age 10, conditional on the Mack model and no later tail.

![Unpaid losses under chain-ladder and BF sensitivities](figures/cl_vs_bf_sensitivity.png)

## What was corrected

The old script removed development age 10 for Mack. That omitted the
**1.016951** age-9-to-10 factor and replaced the 1998 latest
payment with its age-9 value. Projected losses fell by **$36.423M**
and latest paid losses fell by **$4.040M**. The net reserve gap was
**$32.383M (8.49% of manual CL)**.

Mack now uses ages **2-10**. All included years have already reached age 2, so
this preserves every latest payment and every remaining development factor.
Manual and package results agree by accident year within floating-point tolerance.
No factor or tail assumption was changed to force agreement. See the
[package's supported triangle shapes](https://mages.github.io/ChainLadder/reference/MackChainLadder.html).

The missing BF scenario is now generated. Its **CL-implied ELR** is
**40.027289%**, using total CL projected losses divided by total
net earned premium. The calculation keeps full precision: exactly 40% would
produce **$471.167M**, rather than
$471.488M. This is a sensitivity, not an independent
prior or independent validation. The original mature-year paid ELR uses
**1998, 1999, 2000**, selected by `CDF < 1.05`.

## Reproduction

Install **R 4.5.2**, Pandoc (included with RStudio), and a LaTeX
distribution. Download the CSV as described in [DATA_AND_BUILD.md](DATA_AND_BUILD.md).
From the repository root, run:

```sh
Rscript build.R
```

In the RStudio Console, the equivalent is `source("build.R")`. The build restores
`renv.lock`, runs the synthetic tests, then generates all tables, three PNG figures,
this README, and the PDF. First-time dependency restoration needs internet access.
R, Pandoc, and LaTeX are separate system prerequisites; renv pins R packages.

## Data checks and limits

The build checks duplicate records, calendar-year consistency, missing required
observations, numeric development ordering, premium consistency, and development
denominators. Post-2007 losses are excluded from fitting. The negative increment
for accident year 2001 is retained and flagged: **-$12.599M**
at age 7. The local CSV matches the official CAS release byte for byte; the decrease
is in that source. Its economic cause cannot be established from this file.

“Unpaid losses” includes future payments on reported claims as well as unreported
claims; it is more accurate here than treating all projected payments as IBNR.
The final factor has one observed pair. No development beyond age 10 is assumed,
which is a limitation, not proof of settlement. Mack model assumptions have not
been established by the arithmetic checks. The tests check implementation;
**no validation against later runoff outcomes is implemented**.

## Files

- [PDF report](WC_Loss_Reserving_Report.pdf): results, reconciliation, uncertainty and limitations.
- `wc_loss_reserving.R` and `R/reserving.R`: analysis and shared calculation functions.
- `report/report.Rmd` and `report/README.Rmd`: editable document sources.
- `tests/run_tests.R`: 16 synthetic test groups; no CAS data needed.
- `renv.lock`, `DESCRIPTION`, and `renv/`: recorded R dependency environment.
- `figures/`: genuine PNG images with dollar units and integer accident-year labels.
- `outputs/tables/`: generated CSV tables, including the complete reconciliation (local, Git-ignored).
- `outputs/`: build log, input checksum and session details (local, Git-ignored).

## Source

Data accessed from the [CAS loss-reserving data page](https://www.casact.org/publications-research/research/research-resources/loss-reserving-data-pulled-naic-schedule-p),
as compiled for CAS by S&P Global Market Intelligence. The source dataset is not
redistributed. See [CAS terms of use](https://www.casact.org/terms-use) and the acquisition notes.
